introduction: At its core, the video tells the story of director Hilla Rebay’s unrealized plans for an experimental film center in the Guggenheim’s theater. But like a drill boring through geological strata, it also uncovers other narratives—about the foundations of the museum, Frank Lloyd Wright’s architecture, and science-fiction fantasies of alien contact—all of which are tied to the landscape and resources of the American West. Through these interwoven histories, Subterrestrial Cinema ultimately explores the disorientating power of abstraction itself.
